title: FlowAR: Scale-wise Autoregressive Generation Meets Flow Matching
one_line: FlowAR简化VAR结构，用flow matching替代离散自回归生成连续latent
innovations: 简化VAR的复杂多尺度结构为每scale翻倍，去掉对多尺度残差VQ tokenizer的强耦合
将next-scale prediction从离散自回归改为连续flow matching：AR Transformer生成条件语义s_hat_i，flow matching模块从噪声采样到该scale latent s_i
证明FlowAR兼容DC-AE/SD-VAE/MAR-VAE等多种现成连续VAE，模块化替换tokenizer
method_framework: AR Transformer按类别条件逐级生成s_hat_1, s_hat_2, ..., s_hat_n(每级2x上采样)；每级flow matching模块以s_hat_i为条件(通过Spatial-adaLN)，从F0~N(0,I)沿直线插值F_t=t s_i+(1-t)F0训练速度场V_t=s_i-F0；推理时从噪声沿速度场积分到s_i，逐级上采样并AR生成下一级；最终VAE decoder解码图像。
experiment_framework: ImageNet-256与ImageNet-512 class-conditional生成；对比BigGAN/MaskGiT/VQGAN/DiT-XL/VAR-d30/d36；报告FID/IS/Precision/Recall；消融tokenizer兼容性(DC-AE/SD-VAE/MAR-VAE)、per-token vs per-scale、diffusion vs flow matching、语义注入方式。
takeaways: flow matching比diffusion在per-scale设置下FID更低(3.61 vs 6.85 on MAR-VAE)
weaknesses: 仅class-conditional ImageNet评测，未扩展到text-to-image或高分辨率
相对VAR的FID增益约0.1-0.3，幅度有限；创新主要是把离散AR换成连续flow的工程组合
属于图像生成模型，与可靠性/可信AI主线关联弱
